objectives.objective: Establish best practices and standards for survey data modeling in the OMOP CDM

KR1.2: decision-tree guidance for mapping as Facts, Q/A Pairs or Triplets (instrument components, nesting, repeated measures), with a subsection on PVIs.
KR1.3: metadata conventions for provenance (self- vs informant-reported), administration type and mode, and evaluation interval.

objectives.objective: Accelerate standardization of high-impact survey vocabulary content
krs: KR2.1: complete standard vocabulary for at least 3 high-impact content areas (social and behavioral data, validated instruments such as MoCA terms, priority PROMs), organized by content area.
KR2.2: a formal workflow, with governance criteria and submission templates, for promoting mapped custom concepts into the official OMOP vocabulary.
KR2.3: submit at least 2 formal content requests to LOINC and/or SNOMED CT.

objectives.objective: Build and share reusable community resources and implementation tools
krs: KR3.1: publish an instrument mapping best-practices guide (negation, copyright and proprietary instruments, common patterns).
KR3.2: a dedicated OHDSI GitHub repository for ETL scripts, mapping tables and methods, with content from at least 5 organizations.
KR3.3: evaluate existing survey mapping tools (Epiharmony, LLM-assisted approaches), publish findings and prototype or improve at least 1 tool.

KR2 (mid-2026): turn feedback into explicit go / modify / defer decisions for each proposal.
KR3: ship a CDM v5.5 candidate release and get Steering Committee approval, with updated DDLs, docs, R package, migration testing and a summary of community feedback.

CDM WG liaisons contact other WGs for feedback; the timeline may slip because of the Teams outage.

Asks other WGs for data quality checks to ship with their conventions (e.g. eye care visual acuity).
